Chapter 5: Jet-on-Rigid-Wall Calculation

第5章：刚性壁面射流计算

Liquid-only impact theory, a finite-volume reference, and an axisymmetric COMSOL wall-band verification.

纯液体撞击理论、有限体积参考解与轴对称 COMSOL 壁面加密带核验。

What wall pressure can a rigid-wall jet reach, and how well do two independent solvers agree?

射流撞击刚性壁面可达到多大的壁面压力？两个独立求解器的一致性如何？

Map a prescribed jet speed to a wall pressure. Chain closed-form theory, a finite-volume calculation and a COMSOL verification.

把给定射流速度映射为壁面压力。依次给出封闭形式理论、有限体积计算与 COMSOL 核验。

Awaiting answers待作答

Learning goals

学习目标

  • Derive the acoustic and Hugoniot wall pressures of a liquid stopped by a rigid wall.

    推导被刚性壁面截停的液体的声学壁面压力与 Hugoniot 壁面压力。

  • Calculate the planar history with a finite-volume code and read the area-weighted finite-jet observer.

    用有限体积程序计算平面历程，并读取面积加权的有限射流观测量。

  • Verify the result with an axisymmetric model, convergence, balances and a cross-solver comparison, and state its limits.

    用轴对称模型、收敛性、平衡与跨求解器比较核验结果，并说明其局限。

Prerequisite. Prerequisites: Chapter 3’s finite jet, acoustic impact matching and fixed observer.

先修知识。 前提：第三章的有限射流、声学撞击匹配与固定观测量。

1. Problem, inputs and conventions

1. 问题、输入与约定

Find the pressure that a liquid jet of prescribed speed exerts on a rigid wall. Follow three links in order. Theory gives a closed-form reference. A one-dimensional finite-volume code calculates the planar history. An axisymmetric COMSOL model verifies the finite jet.

求给定速度的液体射流作用于刚性壁面的压力。依次沿三个环节推进。理论给出封闭形式的参照。一维有限体积程序计算平面历程。轴对称 COMSOL 模型核验有限射流。

Fix the coordinates first. The rigid wall lies at z=0z=0z=0. The liquid occupies z>0z>0z>0 and moves toward −z-z−z. The radial coordinate rrr measures distance from the jet axis. Time t=0t=0t=0 is the first contact of the liquid front with the wall. The jet radius aaa and the incoming speed UUU are supplied.

先固定坐标。刚性壁面位于 z=0z=0z=0。液体占据 z>0z>0z>0 并朝 −z-z−z 运动。径向坐标 rrr 为到射流轴线的距离。时间 t=0t=0t=0 为液体前沿首次接触壁面的时刻。射流半径 aaa 与入射速度 UUU 为给定值。

State the assumptions. The liquid is the only phase. There is no gas cushion, splash, wall elasticity or cavitation. The wall is flat, rigid and frictionless. The jet side is free, so its pressure is released to the reference pressure pjp_jpj​. Only the first arrival is modelled, up to about one sound-crossing time of the jet radius.

说明假设。液体是唯一的相。不含气垫、飞溅、壁面弹性或空化。壁面平坦、刚性且无摩擦。射流侧面为自由面，其压力释放到参考压力 pjp_jpj​。仅模拟首次到达，时长约为声波穿过射流半径所需时间的一倍。

Chapter 3 bounds the speed a source can give a finite jet. This chapter maps a given speed to a wall pressure. Whether a real source reaches that speed is not decided here. Physical validation against an experiment: Not established. Missing: a measured wall pressure for a real jet.

第三章界定了能源能给有限射流的速度上限。本章把给定速度映射为壁面压力。真实能源能否达到该速度，本章不作判断。对照实验的物理验证：尚未确立。缺少：真实射流的壁面压力实测。

3. Theory: the stopping shock and the Hugoniot pressure

3. 理论：停止激波与 Hugoniot 压力

Step 4 — Describe the stopping shock. At first contact a shock leaves the wall and travels toward +z+z+z at lab speed SSS. Liquid behind it is at rest against the wall. Liquid ahead of it moves toward the wall at speed UUU. Its speed relative to the incoming liquid is Us=U+SU_s=U+SUs​=U+S. Work in the frame of the shock. Liquid enters at speed UsU_sUs​ and leaves at speed S=Us−US=U_s-US=Us​−U.

步骤 4——描述停止激波。首次接触时，激波离开壁面，以实验室速度 SSS 朝 +z+z+z 传播。激波后的液体相对壁面静止，激波前的液体以速度 UUU 朝壁面运动。它相对入射液体的速度为 Us=U+SU_s=U+SUs​=U+S。取激波参考系：液体以速度 UsU_sUs​ 流入，以速度 S=Us−US=U_s-US=Us​−U 流出。

Mass balance across the front gives ρjUs=ρ1S\rho_jU_s=\rho_1Sρj​Us​=ρ1​S. Momentum balance gives pj+ρjUs2=p1+ρ1S2p_j+\rho_jU_s^2=p_1+\rho_1S^2pj​+ρj​Us2​=p1​+ρ1​S2. The fraction of the disk area in that annulus is frel=1−(1−τ)2f_{\mathrm{rel}}=1-(1-\tau)^2frel​=1−(1−τ)2. Step 9 — Count the energy that crosses a plane upstream of the wall. The plane z=2az=2az=2a is hit by the incident liquid before the reflected shock arrives. The reflected shock needs about 2a/(Us−U)=1.202a/(U_s-U)=1.202a/(Us​−U)=1.20 ns to climb back for a=1a=1a=1 μm. Use the window tw=1t_w=1tw​=1 ns. The kinetic-energy flux K˙=12ρjU3πa2\dot K=\tfrac12\rho_jU^3\pi a^2K˙=21​ρj​U3πa2 is 1.5226 mW. Energy through the plane in 1 ns is 1.5226 pJ. This is liquid energy crossing a plane. A rigid wall does no work on the liquid, so it receives none.

Step 15 — Set the boundaries and the initial state. The domain is 0≤r≤a0\le r\le a0≤r≤a and 0≤z≤4a0\le z\le4a0≤z≤4a. The wall is a slip wall. The inflow boundary carries the speed UUU. The side boundary is an outlet at pjp_jpj​, which creates the free side. The liquid starts with a thin onset layer w=−Utanh⁡(z/δ)w=-U\tanh(z/\delta)w=−Utanh(z/δ), δ=0.02a\delta=0.02aδ=0.02a, so that the wall holds it at rest at t=0t=0t=0.

Step 16 — Fix the observers before the comparison. Eq. (C5-E14) defines the transport observers at the plane z=2az=2az=2a and the area-weighted wall pressure at z=0z=0z=0. The same integrals serve every mesh and every case. Mass flux and kinetic-energy flux through the plane check the prescribed inflow. The mass-flux-weighted incident speed over 0 to 1 ns is 99.0272 m s⁻¹, which differs from UUU by less than 10−510^{-5}10−5 percent. The incident energy over the same window is 1.52258 pJ, which differs from Eq. (C5-E08) by less than 10−510^{-5}10−5 percent.

7. Verification: convergence, balances and the cross-check

7. 核验：收敛、平衡与交叉检验

Step 17 — Judge mesh convergence by the peak of the full-sensor mean. Global refinement beyond about 64,000 elements exceeds the available memory. The peak forms about 0.03 ns after contact and within about 0.05 aaa of the wall. So refine only a wall band r≤ar\le ar≤a, z≤0.15az\le0.15az≤0.15a and keep the rest of the mesh fixed. Eq. (C5-E15) defines the relative error and the successive change. The denominator of the change is the previous, coarser value.

步骤 17——以全传感区平均的峰值判断网格收敛。全局加密超过约 64,000 单元时超出可用内存。峰值在接触后约 0.03 ns、距壁面约 0.05 aaa 以内形成。因此仅加密壁面带 r≤ar\le ar≤a、z≤0.15az\le0.15az≤0.15a，其余网格保持不变。式（C5-E15）定义了相对误差与逐次变化量，变化量的分母为前一个较粗网格的值。

The successive changes fall from 1.98% to 0.44% and then to 0.02%. The converged full-sensor peak is 162.6 MPa. It is 0.931 of pHp_HpH​, that is 6.9% below the reference. The converged centre-disk peak is 174.37 MPa, 0.14% from pHp_HpH​.

逐次变化量由 1.98% 降至 0.44%，再降至 0.02%。收敛的全传感区峰值为 162.6 MPa，为 pHp_HpH​ 的 0.931 倍，即比参照值低 6.9%。收敛的中心圆盘峰值为 174.37 MPa，与 pHp_HpH​ 相差 0.14%。

Step 18 — Check the time step. A run with strict steps and relative tolerance 10−310^{-3}10−3 on the 16,136-element mesh gives a full-sensor peak of 168.106 MPa. The automatic-step run gives 169.359 MPa. They differ by 0.74% of the automatic value. A time-step study at the finest band is not done.

步骤 18——检查时间步。在 16,136 单元网格上，采用严格步长、相对容差 10−310^{-3}10−3 的运行给出全传感区峰值 168.106 MPa，自动步长运行给出 169.359 MPa，二者相差自动步长值的 0.74%。最细加密带上的时间步研究尚未进行。

Step 19 — Audit the conservation laws. Close the column on the sides so nothing leaves sideways. Eq. (C5-E16) then compares the change of axial momentum and of mass with their own boundary integrals over 0 to 3 ns. The momentum residual is 0.106% and the mass residual is 0.018%. These residuals test the solver, not the physics.

步骤 19——审计守恒律。将液柱侧面封闭，使侧向无流出。式（C5-E16）在 0 至 3 ns 内把轴向动量与质量的变化同各自的边界积分比较。动量残差为 0.106%，质量残差为 0.018%。这些残差检验的是求解器，而不是物理。

Step 20 — Compare the two solvers on the same problem. Both integrate the confined planar column with the same law, inputs, wall and inflow. Interpolate the C++ history onto the 361 COMSOL sample times between 0.2 and 2.0 ns. Eq. (C5-E17) gives a relative L2 difference of 0.034% and a largest pointwise difference of 0.096%. (C5-E20) · Reference formulas: speed bound and pressure map together

参考公式：速度上界与压力映射合并

pwall≤pj+Usc0 Z0 U(centre disk),pwall≈Λ pH(full sensor),U≤2Eavmj(Chapter 3 energy bound).\begin{aligned}p_{\mathrm{wall}}&\le p_j+\frac{U_s}{c_0}\,Z_0\,U\quad(\text{centre disk}),\qquad p_{\mathrm{wall}}\approx\Lambda\,p_H\quad(\text{full sensor}),\\ U&\le\sqrt{\frac{2E_{\mathrm{av}}}{m_j}}\quad(\text{Chapter 3 energy bound}).\end{aligned}pwall​U​≤pj​+c0​Us​​Z0​U(centre disk),pwall​≈ΛpH​(full sensor),≤mj​2Eav​​​(Chapter 3 energy bound).​

Start from the energy bound. Chapter 3 limits the speed by the energy available to the finite jet mass. This chapter takes the speed as given and maps it to pressure. At 99.027 m s⁻¹ the linear ceiling is 160.765 MPa excess. The nonlinear factor 1.0856 gives 174.52 MPa excess, which is the Hugoniot level. Over the full sensor the peak is 0.931 of the absolute Hugoniot pressure, 162.6 MPa. These numbers hold for the prescribed speed. They say nothing on whether a source delivers that speed.

从能量上界出发。第三章用有限射流质量可得的能量来限制速度。本章把速度当作给定值并映射为压力。在 99.027 m s⁻¹ 时，线性上限为 160.765 MPa 超压。非线性因子 1.0856 给出 174.52 MPa 超压，即 Hugoniot 水平。在整个传感区上，峰值为绝对 Hugoniot 压力的 0.931 倍，即 162.6 MPa。这些数值对应于给定速度，并不说明能源能否提供该速度。

A bound and a map are different claims. The bound says a speed cannot be exceeded. The map says what pressure follows from a speed under stated assumptions. Neither is a prediction of the pressure a given laser pulse produces. That needs the upstream chain of Chapters 1 to 3 and a measurement.

上界与映射是不同的结论。上界说明速度不可超过某值。映射说明在所述假设下某一速度对应何种压力。二者都不是对给定激光脉冲所产生压力的预测。那需要第一至第三章的上游链条以及实测。

Review criteria

  • Separates the Chapter 3 speed bound from the speed-to-pressure map and states that the speed is prescribed.

  • Names the conditions: liquid only, rigid flat wall, barotropic law, first arrival and the tested ranges.

    指出条件：纯液体、刚性平壁、正压律、首次到达以及检验范围。

The free side of the jet acts from first contact. A release front from the edge reaches the radius a(1−τ)a(1-\tau)a(1−τ) at dimensionless time τ\tauτ. At the peak time 0.029 ns, τ=0.0472\tau=0.0472τ=0.0472 and the released annulus holds 9.2% of the disk area. Full release of that annulus gives 0.908 pH0.908\,p_H0.908pH​. The computed factor 0.931 requires the annulus to keep about a quarter of its excess pressure. The sign and size agree with the scale estimate.

射流的自由侧边自首次接触起就在起作用。边缘的释放前沿在无量纲时间 τ\tauτ 到达半径 a(1−τ)a(1-\tau)a(1−τ)。在峰值时刻 0.029 ns，τ=0.0472\tau=0.0472τ=0.0472，已释放环带占圆盘面积的 9.2%。该环带完全释放时给出 0.908 pH0.908\,p_H0.908pH​。算得的因子 0.931 要求环带保留约四分之一的超压。符号与大小与尺度估计一致。

Evidence against a mesh artifact: the band refinement changes the peak by 1.98%, 0.44% and 0.02%. The factor is the same within 0.12% for five speeds and radii. The centre disk, which the release has not reached, stays within 0.43% of pHp_HpH​. A mesh artifact would not be confined to the full-area average and would not collapse with τ\tauτ.

反对网格伪影的证据：加密带使峰值依次改变 1.98%、0.44% 和 0.02%；五组速度与半径下该因子的偏差在 0.12% 以内；释放尚未到达的中心圆盘保持在 pHp_HpH​ 的 0.43% 以内。网格伪影不会只出现在全面积平均上，也不会随 τ\tauτ 坍缩。

Review criteria

    说明尺度估计只确定符号与大小而非数字，0.931 来自模拟。

0.034% 的求解器一致性确立了什么？162.6 MPa 的哪些用途仍无依据？

The relative L2 difference of 0.034% between the C++ and COMSOL histories shows that two implementations of one model agree. Both use the same stiffened-gas law, inputs, wall and inflow. A shared modelling error would appear in both. So the agreement cannot validate the law, the neglect of gas or the rigid wall. It supports a statement about numerics only.

C++ 与 COMSOL 历程之间 0.034% 的相对 L2 差表明同一模型的两个实现是一致的。二者使用相同的刚化气体律、输入、壁面和入流。共同的建模误差会同时出现在两者之中。因此这一致性不能验证该定律、对气相的忽略或刚性壁面，它只支持关于数值的陈述。

The 162.6 MPa result is supported as a numerical result for a liquid-only column at 0.031≤M≤0.0920.031\le M\le0.0920.031≤M≤0.092 and 0.5≤a≤20.5\le a\le20.5≤a≤2 μm during the first arrival. It is not supported as a prediction of a measured wall pressure, as a value after τ≈1\tau\approx1τ≈1, or as a value with a gas cushion or an elastic wall. Physical validation: Not established. Missing: a measured wall pressure for a real jet.

162.6 MPa 作为数值结果成立，条件是纯液体液柱、0.031≤M≤0.0920.031\le M\le0.0920.031≤M≤0.092、0.5≤a≤20.5\le a\le20.5≤a≤2 μm 且处于首次到达阶段。它不支持作为实测壁面压力的预测，不支持 τ≈1\tau\approx1τ≈1 之后的数值，也不支持含气垫或弹性壁面的情形。物理验证：尚未确立。缺少：真实射流的壁面压力实测。
